product_overview: Web application for tenant schools to sign in, manage grant budgets (allocate, track, export) and record credits/debits across academic years and terms. Developers can administer multi-school accounts and subscriptions via a developer dashboard.
core_goals: Sign in to a tenant school account and access the school's grant workspace
Initialize and allocate grant budgets for a given academic year and term
Record and manage credits and debits against the school's budget
Track budget usage and view grant summaries and itemized breakdowns
Export budget data to Excel for offline review or reporting
Adjust school configuration and administrative settings

features.name: School login
features.description: Authenticate as a school tenant (or developer mode) using username and password to reach the school dashboard and workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill username -> Fill password -> Optionally enable developer login mode -> Submit login form -> See /home dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Submit login form with missing password -> See validation error message on /login

features.name: Grant budget workspace
features.description: Access the school's home dashboard and navigate to budget, credits, debits and tracking to view and manage grant finances for the current academic year and term.
user_flows: Navigate to /home -> Navigate to /budget -> View tables and summaries for current academic year and term -> Edit budget allocations -> Submit budget update -> Navigate to /grant-summary -> See updated grant totals
Navigate to /credits -> Fill credit form -> Submit credit form -> See new credit listed and budget totals updated
Navigate to /credits -> Submit credit form with missing required field -> See validation error message on /credits
Navigate to /debits -> View debits register and select a debit in the list -> Trigger in-list document action or preview -> See available document options or preview in the debits view
Navigate to /tracking -> View budget tracking and reporting for current academic year and term
Navigate to /initialize_budget -> Provide academic year and term details -> Submit initialization -> Navigate to /budget -> See newly initialized budget
Navigate to /budget -> Navigate to /export_budget_excel -> Download Excel file of the current budget

features.name: Settings
features.description: View and update school-level configuration and metadata that affect the tenant account.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> View current school settings -> Modify a setting value -> Submit settings form -> See updated setting reflected in the UI

features.name: Password reset (OTP) and set new password
features.description: Use an OTP verification flow to set a new password for an authenticated user session.
user_flows: Navigate to /request-otp -> Request OTP for password change -> Receive OTP -> Enter OTP -> Submit OTP -> Navigate to /create-new-password -> Enter new password -> Submit new password -> See confirmation and return to /login or /home
Navigate to /request-otp -> Enter incorrect OTP -> Submit OTP -> See validation error message on /request-otp

features.name: Developer dashboard (multi-school administration)
features.description: Developer-facing area to view and administer multiple school accounts and subscription status.
user_flows: Navigate to /dev/dashboard -> View list of schools and subscription statuses -> Inspect a school's row in the list -> Modify subscription or metadata in-list -> Submit changes -> See updated status in /dev/dashboard

features.name: Itemized and tracking views
features.description: Inspect detailed itemized budget breakdowns and tracking reports to understand spend and allocations.
user_flows: Navigate to /itemized -> View itemized budget breakdown for the current academic year and term
Navigate to /tracking -> View trend and status reports for budget tracking

features.name: Logout
features.description: End the current authenticated session and return to the login screen.
user_flows: From any authenticated page (e.g. /home) -> Trigger logout action -> Navigate to /logout -> See /login page

routes.description: Redirects to login if unauthenticated; otherwise home or developer dashboard.
School or developer login; optional password-reset OTP flow trigger.
Dashboard after school login showing grant totals and academic context.
Password change OTP step (OTP shown in console in debug).
Set new password after OTP verification (POST handlers in app.py).
Ends session and returns to login.
Developer multi-school administration (school accounts and subscriptions).
Grant summary overview for current school/year/term.
Initialize budget for academic year and term.
Loose minute document for a debit.

known_limitations.issue: Flask development server runs with debug reload; concurrent automated browser hits may overload or reload mid-test compared to production WSGI.
known_limitations.impact: TestSprite may limit test count when serverMode is development.

known_limitations.issue: Password-reset OTP appears in server console logs in debug, not emailed to users in local dev.
known_limitations.impact: E2E tests for OTP must coordinate with console/logs or seeded state.
